indicator.name: CNN Fear & Greed Index
indicator.description: CNN Business's composite measure of market fear and greed, on a 0-100 scale.
indicator.methodology: CNN Fear & Greed Index on its published 0-100 scale. The component is contrarian: score = 100 - index. Fear can create opportunity but is not proof of undervaluation.
indicator.limitations: No public authorized API is bundled. The indicator stays unavailable unless an authorized feed is configured. A separate VIX/RSI sentiment proxy is displayed and explicitly labeled; it is not substituted for CNN data.
